headline: OpenMAS-GCom reports controlled diagnosis of multi-agent system components
summary: An arXiv paper introduces OpenMAS-GCom, a benchmark that compares multi-agent configurations with one component changed while tasks, models, prompts and budget limits are held fixed. The paper reports 17 configurations across 29 datasets in six domains, four interventions, and 400 frozen multi-document tasks requiring source-aware conflict resolution. In a five-dataset aggregate, it reports a 3.58 percentage-point mean score loss after specialist removal versus 0.58 points after critic removal. These are author-reported benchmark results; independent reproduction and broader task-weighted interpretation remain open.
